title: The Three Rocks of Glory: Confirmed Truths Set in Ultimates
arc: From a single appointment by the Greatness, three confirmed truths in ultimates are set into the outer worlds — the bearing pillar that lifts the cosmos, the new land of light pressed down upon the land of darkness, and the great Thought that is Jesus the Radiance — together forming the threefold foundation by which the redemptive economy stands fast.
reading:
This teaching surveys three "rocks" (ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲁ) — three confirmed truths fixed in ultimates — that the Father of Greatness has appointed and set into the worlds that lie outside, that is, into the cosmos of the mingled state. The image of rock signals that what is described here is doctrine made immovable: divine truth so consolidated that it serves as a foundation against which the falsities of self-love can no longer prevail. Because the rocks are three, they constitute the fullness of a complete process; each is established in its own great place, and together they articulate the entire structure by which the Greatness reaches into, presses down upon, and calls back what has fallen.

The first rock is the Pillar of Glory, named here as the Perfect Man whom the Ambassador summoned forth and clothed in glory, set within a cosmic Zone or girdle. This rock is the axis of ascent in its bearing aspect: he sets his foot from below to above and bears the whole cosmos upward, becoming foremost of all the heaven-bearers and, in his strength, raising himself and establishing the heavenly states of those above and those below. Read correspondentially, this is the divine bearing-up — the Omophoros-function of accumulated truth standing as a column from the lowest natural to the celestial, the path along which all redeemed light travels home. It is the truth that supports: without it the natural cannot rise, and nothing of what has been gathered out of the mingling can ascend.

The second rock is the new Land of Light placed upon the Land of Darkness. Where the first rock rises, this second rock descends and presses down: it humbles the stings of the rear of the storehouse of death, prepares its strengthening in great firmness on the outer side upon the land of darkness, and presses, submerges, and stings the very root of death. This is the Adamas-of-Light function — the warrior-image of regenerative truth pinned down upon concupiscence so that hell's storehouse cannot break upward. It is divine truth in its subduing aspect, a celestial state established as a lid over the proprium, holding the falsities-from-evil in their bondage so that the pillar of ascent can do its work without being overrun from below. Note the symmetry: the first rock lifts the cosmos upward; the second presses the abyss downward. Between them the worlds are held in their order.

The third rock is the great Thought (ⲡⲛⲁⲃ ⲙ̄ⲙⲉⲩⲉ) whom the Father summoned forth — Jesus the Glorious One, Jesus the Radiance. Where the first rock bears and the second subdues, the third rock awakens. He is the inner rational principle of divine truth made manifest as Redeemer, the shining-forth that calls the captive light into hearing. As "Thought" he stands among the discrete faculties of reception; as "Jesus the Radiance" he is that thought made luminous and active — the saving truth emitted into the worlds to release what is bound. Without this third rock the bearing and the subduing would have no voice; with it the whole redemptive economy speaks.

The teaching concludes by gathering the three together: these are the three great rocks that came forth out of a great trust, appointed in three great honored places, spread forth in three great places of the worlds, established according to the purpose-of-heart of the Greatness. The point of the summation is that the threefold foundation is not improvised in response to the cosmic war but issued from a single intention of the Father. Bearing pillar, subduing land, and awakening Thought are one decree articulated in three discrete registers — ascent, restraint, and call — and because they are rocks, the whole regenerative work of the cosmos rests upon truths that cannot be moved.
